This is the diagram I would use when discussing the future direction of TAF with the governance group.


```{mermaid}
flowchart TB

    Stakeholder[Stakeholder]

    Explorer["TAF Explorer<br/>R Shiny"]

    Metadata["(TAF Metadata DB)"]

    Outputs["(TAF Outputs)"]

    InputData[Input Data Tab]

    Diagnostics[Model Diagnostics Tab]

    Forecast[Forecast Diagnostics Tab]

    QC[Quality Checks Tab]

    Stakeholder --> Explorer

    Explorer --> Metadata

    Explorer --> Outputs

    Explorer --> InputData
    Explorer --> Diagnostics
    Explorer --> Forecast
    Explorer --> QC

    InputData --> Outputs
    Diagnostics --> Outputs
    Forecast --> Outputs
    QC --> Outputs
```
